Class Card

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.model.cards.Card
Direct Known Subclasses:
Building, DeckCard
public abstract class Card extends Object
The abstract base class representing a generic card within the game.

This class defines the core attributes shared by all cards, such as their historical era/age and a unique identifier. It enforces the contract for applying card effects and validating whether a card can be picked or purchased by a specific player.

    • applyEffect

      public abstract void applyEffect(Player player, Game context)
      Applies the card's unique game effect to the player or the broader game context.

      This method must be implemented by all concrete subclasses extending Card. It is designed to be triggered immediately when a player successfully drafts, triggers, or purchases the card during their turn.

      Parameters:
      player - the Player currently interacting with or claiming the card
      context - the current Game state and orchestration context

    • isPickable

      public abstract boolean isPickable(Player player)
      Evaluates whether the card is currently eligible to be picked or purchased by the given player.

      The business logic varies significantly depending on the concrete type of the card:

      • Character Cards: Typically return true as they are freely draftable.
      • Event Cards: Typically return false as they are resolved globally rather than kept.
      • Building Cards: Return true only if the player currently meets the specific resource or food requirements to afford them; false otherwise.
      Parameters:
      player - the Player trying to pick or purchase this card
      Returns:
      true if the card satisfies the picking conditions for the player; false otherwise
